-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvRaftlog` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def pendKsn (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) (K : List SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ sid,
        ⌜snap = some sid⌝ -∗
          ∃ sv,
            ownSnapS p DFrac.discard sv ∗
              ⌜snapId sv = sid⌝ ∗
                ⌜snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists ∈ K⌝ ∗ ⌜∃ x, sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists.Has x⌝)

def initKsnCert (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] k ∈ initKsn σ, storCert st k

theorem SnpOk.keep {g : NGhost} {ls ls' : LogState} (H : SnpOk g ls) (hk : SnpKeep ls ls') (hsn :
    ls'.snap = ls.snap) (hcm : uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls'.committed) : SnpOk g ls'

def ownRaftLog (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ lv σ,
      "Hl" ∷ typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "%Hcm" ∷ ⌜lv.committed' = ls.committed⌝ ∗
          "%Hap" ∷ ⌜lv.applied' = ls.applied⌝ ∗
            "%Hapg" ∷ ⌜lv.applying' = ls.applying⌝ ∗
              "%Hip" ∷ ⌜lv.unstable'.offsetInProgress' = ls.inprogress⌝ ∗
                "%Hsip" ∷ ⌜lv.unstable'.snapshotInProgress' = ls.sip⌝ ∗
                  "%Hsipn" ∷ ⌜ls.snap = none → ls.sip = false⌝ ∗
                    "%Hasz" ∷ ⌜lv.applyingEntsSize' = ls.apsize⌝ ∗
                      "%Hamx" ∷ ⌜lv.maxApplyingEntsSize' = ls.apmax⌝ ∗
                        "%Hidx" ∷ ⌜LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)⌝ ∗
                          "%Hnowrap" ∷ ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
                            "#HisStorage" ∷ isStorage lv.storage' ∗
                              "HStorage" ∷ lentStor ls.lent lv.storage' σ ∗
                                "%Hstore" ∷ ⌜LogStoreOk ls.snap σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents⌝ ∗
                                  "#Husnap" ∷ ownSnap lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap ∗
                                    "%Hsksn" ∷
                                        ⌜σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 →
                                            { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈ ls.ksn⌝ ∗
                                      "#Hpksn" ∷ pendKsn lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap ls.ksn ∗
                                        ("#Hkcert" ∷ [∗list] k ∈ ls.ksn, storCert lv.storage' k) ∗
                                          "%Hoffset" ∷
                                              ⌜uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' =
                                                  uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1⌝ ∗
                                            "Huents" ∷ entsRO lv.unstable'.entries' ls.uents ∗
                                              "Huents_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc lv.unstable'.entries' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                "%Happlied" ∷
                                                    ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧
                                                        uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed⌝ ∗
                                                  "%Hpapplied" ∷
                                                      ⌜ls.snap = none → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied⌝ ∗
                                                    "%Hcommitted" ∷
                                                        ⌜uint.Z ls.committed ≤
                                                            uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length⌝ ∗
                                                      "%Hssnap" ∷
                                                          ⌜ls.snap = none →
                                                              StoredSnapOk σ ls.committed ls.prev
                                                                (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)⌝ ∗
                                                        "#Hl_logger" ∷ isLoggerVal lv.logger' ∗
                                                          "#Hu_logger" ∷ isLoggerVal lv.unstable'.logger' ∗
                                                            "%Hipb" ∷
                                                                ⌜uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧
                                                                    uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤
                                                                      uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' + ↑ls.uents.length⌝ ∗
                                                              "%Hpersist" ∷
                                                                  ⌜ls.snap = none →
                                                                      LogPersistOk σ ls.sents ls.uents
                                                                        (uint.Z ls.inprogress -
                                                                          uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset')
                                                                        ls.unpersisted ls.stored⌝ ∗
                                                                "%Happlying" ∷
                                                                    ⌜uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧
                                                                        uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed⌝ ∗
                                                                  "%Hpaused" ∷
                                                                      ⌜lv.applyingEntsPaused' = false →
                                                                          uint.Z ls.apsize < uint.Z ls.apmax⌝ ∗
                                                                    "%Hstor" ∷ ⌜lv.storage' = ls.storage⌝ ∗
                                                                      "%Hpend" ∷ ⌜PendLogOk σ ls⌝ ∗
                                                                        "%Hfl" ∷ ⌜FlOk σ ls⌝ ∗
                                                                          "%Hlent" ∷ ⌜ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none⌝ ∗
                                                                            "%Hq" ∷ ⌜ls.sapp = false ∧ ls.aps = false⌝ ∗
                                                                              "%Hprel" ∷ ⌜SipOk ls lv.unstable'.offset'⌝ ∗
                                                                                "%Hsat" ∷ ⌜ls.sat = true → SatOk σ ls⌝)

def SipOk (ls : LogState) (off : w64) : Prop :=
  (ls.sip = true → LogPersistRel ls.sents ls.uents (uint.Z ls.inprogress - uint.Z off) ls.stored) ∧
    (ls.snap ≠ none → ls.sip = false → ls.inprogress = off ∧ uint.Z ls.applying < uint.Z ls.prev.index')

theorem initKsnCert_zero (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) (h : σ.ss.index' = W64 0) : ⊢ initKsnCert st
    σ

theorem ownRaftLog_fl [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗
    ⌜uint.Z ls.fl ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z
    ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length ∧ (ls.snap = none →
    uint.Z ls.fl < uint.Z ls.inprogress)⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem LogPersistRel_full (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int) : LogPersistRel sents uents ipo
    (sents ++ uents)

syntax tacticReseal_raftLog

syntax tacticClose_unstable

theorem persist_prefix_truncate.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} (sents uents ents : List A) (m kip k' : Nat)
    (Hkip : kip ≤ uents.length) (Hm : m ≤ sents.length + uents.length) (Hlt : m < sents.length +
    uents.length → k' ≤ kip ∧ k' ≤ m - sents.length) (Heq : m = sents.length + uents.length → k' =
    kip) : List.take m sents ++ List.take k' (List.take (m - sents.length) uents ++ ents) <+: sents
    ++ List.take kip uents

def LogPersistOk (σ : StorState) (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int) (pend stored : List EntryM)
    : Prop :=
  sents ++ List.take ipo.toNat uents <+: storApp σ pend ∧
    (ipo.toNat = uents.length → sents ++ uents = storApp σ pend) ∧ (uents = [] → pend = []) ∧ storApp σ pend = stored

theorem logTruncateAppend_snpKeep (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) : SnpKeep ls
    (logTruncateAppend ls ents)

theorem ownRaftLog_setCommitted [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (n : w64) (Hlo
    : uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z n) (Hhi : uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length +
    ↑ls.uents.length) (Happ : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z n) (Hcm : uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z n)
    (Φ : val → IProp GF) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗ (ownRaftLog l { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents,
    uents := ls.uents, committed := n, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress :=
    ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored,
    apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip
    := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt } -∗ Φ
    (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (intoVal (structFieldRef raftLog go!"committed" l) <-[go.uint64] intoVal n)
    {{ Φ }}

theorem ownRaftLog_quiet [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls
    -∗ ⌜ls.sapp = false ∧ ls.aps = false⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem unstableOf.proj_ksn (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).ksn = ls.ksn

theorem pendKsn_none [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (K : List SnapTrip) : ⊢ pendKsn p none K

syntax tacticOpen_unstable

theorem isLoggerVal_pers (x : GoInterface) : Persistent (isLoggerVal x)

theorem unstableOf.proj_inprogress (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).inprogress =
    ls.inprogress

def snapHit (snap : Option entryID) (i : w64) : Bool :=
  match snap with
  | some sid => decide (sid.index' = i)
  | none => false

theorem lentStor_close {b : Bool} (h : b = false) (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : ownStorage st σ ⊢
    lentStor b st σ

theorem raftLog_split_unstable [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) : ⊢
    typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l)
    lv.unstable' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ∀ uv, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l) uv
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ typedPointsto l { storage' := lv.storage', unstable' := uv, committed' :=
    lv.committed', applying' := lv.applying', applied' := lv.applied', logger' := lv.logger',
    maxApplyingEntsSize' := lv.maxApplyingEntsSize', applyingEntsSize' := lv.applyingEntsSize',
    applyingEntsPaused' := lv.applyingEntsPaused' } (DFrac.own 1)

def ownRaftLogW (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ lv σ,
      "Hl" ∷ typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "%Hcm" ∷ ⌜lv.committed' = ls.committed⌝ ∗
          "%Hap" ∷ ⌜lv.applied' = ls.applied⌝ ∗
            "%Hapg" ∷ ⌜lv.applying' = ls.applying⌝ ∗
              "%Hip" ∷ ⌜lv.unstable'.offsetInProgress' = ls.inprogress⌝ ∗
                "%Hsip" ∷ ⌜lv.unstable'.snapshotInProgress' = ls.sip⌝ ∗
                  "%Hsipn" ∷ ⌜ls.snap = none → ls.sip = false⌝ ∗
                    "%Hasz" ∷ ⌜lv.applyingEntsSize' = ls.apsize⌝ ∗
                      "%Hamx" ∷ ⌜lv.maxApplyingEntsSize' = ls.apmax⌝ ∗
                        "%Hidx" ∷ ⌜LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)⌝ ∗
                          "%Hnowrap" ∷ ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
                            "#HisStorage" ∷ isStorage lv.storage' ∗
                              "HStorage" ∷ lentStor ls.lent lv.storage' σ ∗
                                "%Hstore" ∷ ⌜LogStoreOk (snapV ls) σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents⌝ ∗
                                  "#Husnap" ∷ ownSnap lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap ∗
                                    "%Hsksn" ∷
                                        ⌜σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 →
                                            { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈ ls.ksn⌝ ∗
                                      "#Hpksn" ∷ pendKsn lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap ls.ksn ∗
                                        ("#Hkcert" ∷ [∗list] k ∈ ls.ksn, storCert lv.storage' k) ∗
                                          "%Hoffset" ∷
                                              ⌜uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' =
                                                  uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1⌝ ∗
                                            "Huents" ∷ entsRO lv.unstable'.entries' ls.uents ∗
                                              "Huents_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc lv.unstable'.entries' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                "%Happlied" ∷
                                                    ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧
                                                        uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed⌝ ∗
                                                  "%Hpapplied" ∷
                                                      ⌜ls.snap = none →
                                                          ls.aps = false → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied⌝ ∗
                                                    "%Hcommitted" ∷
                                                        ⌜uint.Z ls.committed ≤
                                                            uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length⌝ ∗
                                                      "%Hssnap" ∷
                                                          ⌜snapV ls = none →
                                                              StoredSnapOk σ ls.committed ls.prev
                                                                (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)⌝ ∗
                                                        "#Hl_logger" ∷ isLoggerVal lv.logger' ∗
                                                          "#Hu_logger" ∷ isLoggerVal lv.unstable'.logger' ∗
                                                            "%Hipb" ∷
                                                                ⌜uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧
                                                                    uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤
                                                                      uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' + ↑ls.uents.length⌝ ∗
                                                              "%Hpersist" ∷
                                                                  ⌜snapV ls = none →
                                                                      LogPersistOk σ ls.sents ls.uents
                                                                        (uint.Z ls.inprogress -
                                                                          uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset')
                                                                        ls.unpersisted ls.stored⌝ ∗
                                                                "%Happlying" ∷
                                                                    ⌜uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧
                                                                        uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed⌝ ∗
                                                                  "%Hpaused" ∷
                                                                      ⌜lv.applyingEntsPaused' = false →
                                                                          uint.Z ls.apsize < uint.Z ls.apmax⌝ ∗
                                                                    "%Hstor" ∷ ⌜lv.storage' = ls.storage⌝ ∗
                                                                      "%Hpend" ∷ ⌜PendLogOk σ ls⌝ ∗
                                                                        "%Hfl" ∷ ⌜FlOk σ ls⌝ ∗
                                                                          "%Hlent" ∷ ⌜ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none⌝ ∗
                                                                            "%Hsappi" ∷ ⌜ls.sapp = true → SappOk σ ls⌝ ∗
                                                                              "%Hprel" ∷ ⌜SipOk ls lv.unstable'.offset'⌝ ∗
                                                                                "%Hsat" ∷ ⌜ls.sat = true → SatOk σ ls⌝)

theorem ownSnap_of_eq_some [package_sem : Assumptions] {p : Loc} {snap : Option entryID} {sid :
    entryID} (Hs : snap = some sid) : ownSnap p snap ⊢ ∃ sv, ownSnapM p DFrac.discard sv ∗
    ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = sid.index' ∧ sv.Metadata'.Term' = sid.term'⌝

syntax tacticTake_storage_

theorem unstableOf.proj_ents (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).ents = ls.uents

def LogPersistRel (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int) (stored : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  sents ++ List.take ipo.toNat uents <+: stored ∧ (ipo.toNat = uents.length → sents ++ uents = stored)

def ownSnap (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) : IProp GF :=
  ownSnapDef p snap

theorem ownSnap_Some [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (sid : entryID) : ownSnap p (some sid) ⊣⊢
    ∃ sv, ownSnapM p DFrac.discard sv ∗ ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = sid.index' ∧ sv.Metadata'.Term' =
    sid.term'⌝

def snapV (ls : LogState) : Option entryID :=
  if ls.sapp = true then none else ls.snap

theorem ownRaftLog_nowrap [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls
    -∗ ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

def ownUnstable (u : Loc) (us : UnstableSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ uv,
      "Hu" ∷ typedPointsto u uv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hents_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc uv.entries' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "Hents" ∷ entsRO uv.entries' us.ents ∗
            "#Hsnap" ∷ ownSnap uv.snapshot' us.snap ∗
              "#Hpksn" ∷ pendKsn uv.snapshot' us.snap us.ksn ∗
                "#Hlogger" ∷ isLoggerVal uv.logger' ∗
                  "%Hoff" ∷ ⌜uv.offset' = us.offset⌝ ∗
                    "%Hoip" ∷ ⌜uv.offsetInProgress' = us.inprogress⌝ ∗ "%Hsip" ∷ ⌜uv.snapshotInProgress' = us.sip⌝)

def SnpExt (g : NGhost) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : SnapTrip),
    g.snp = some k →
      ls.lent = false →
        (ls.snap ≠ none → uint.Z k.sid.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.sxt) ∧
          (ls.snap = none → ls.aps = false → uint.Z k.sid.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applying)

def StoredSnapOk (σ : StorState) (cm : w64) (prev : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ uint.Z σ.ss.index' ≤ uint.Z cm ∧ plogTermAt prev es σ.ss.index' = some σ.ss.term'

theorem LogPersistOk.rel {σ : StorState} {sents uents : List EntryM} {ipo : Int} {pend stored : List
    EntryM} (H : LogPersistOk σ sents uents ipo pend stored) : LogPersistRel sents uents ipo stored

theorem SnpOk.of_none {g : NGhost} {ls : LogState} (hlt : ls.lent = g.slent) (hsnp : g.snp = none)
    (hsip : ls.sip = false) (hsat : ls.sat = false) : SnpOk g ls

theorem lent_false_of {ls : LogState} (H : ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none) (Hs : ls.snap = none) :
    ls.lent = false

theorem snap_some_or_none (snap : Option entryID) : (∃ sid, snap = some sid) ∨ snap = none

theorem ownRaftLog_absorb [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (σa : StorState) : ⊢
    ownRaftLog l ls -∗ appendedTok ls.storage σa ls.unpersisted ==∗ ownRaftLog l { prev := ls.prev,
    sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap :=
    ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := [], stored :=
    ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl :=
    ls.fl, sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt :=
    ls.sxt }

theorem unstableOf.proj_snap (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).snap = ls.snap

theorem snapV_sapp {ls : LogState} (h : ls.sapp = true) : snapV ls = none

theorem pendKsn_pers (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) (K : List SnapTrip) : Persistent (pendKsn p
    snap K)

theorem SnpKeep.refl (ls : LogState) : SnpKeep ls ls

syntax tacticOpen_unstable_again

def SatOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  ls.snap = some ls.prev ∧
    ls.sip = true ∧
      ls.lent = false ∧ ls.unpersisted = [] ∧ σ.prev = ls.prev ∧ σ.ss = ls.prev ∧ σ.ents = ls.stored ∧ σ.pend = []

def initKsn (σ : StorState) : List SnapTrip :=
  if σ.ss.index' = W64 0 then [] else [{ sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat }]

theorem SnpOk.of_quiet {g : NGhost} {ls : LogState} (hlt : ls.lent = g.slent) (hsn : ls.snap = none)
    (hsip : ls.sip = false) (hsat : ls.sat = false) (hk : ∀ (k : SnapTrip), g.snp = some k → k ∈
    ls.ksn ∧ uint.Z k.sid.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed) (hx : SnpExt g ls) : SnpOk g ls

theorem ownSnap_of_eq_none [package_sem : Assumptions] {p : Loc} {snap : Option entryID} (Hs : snap
    = none) : ownSnap p snap ⊢ ⌜p = null⌝

structure UnstableSt : Type where
  ents : List EntryM
  offset : w64
  inprogress : w64
  snap : Option entryID
  ksn : List SnapTrip
  sip : Bool

def isLoggerVal (x : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ lg, ⌜x = GoInterface.ok lg⌝ ∗ isLogger lg)

theorem ownRaftLogW_quiet [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (Hq : ls.sapp =
    false ∧ ls.aps = false) : ownRaftLogW l ls ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem initKsnCert_pers (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : Persistent (initKsnCert st σ)

theorem ownRaftLogW_quietW [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLogW l
    ls -∗ ⌜ls.sapp = false ∧ ls.aps = false⌝ -∗ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem storExt_of_inv {σ : StorState} {ls : LogState} {off : w64} (Hstore : LogStoreOk ls.snap σ
    ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents) (Hoff : uint.Z off = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1)
    (Hipb : uint.Z off ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧ uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤ uint.Z off +
    ↑ls.uents.length) (Hpersist : ls.snap = none → LogPersistOk σ ls.sents ls.uents (uint.Z
    ls.inprogress - uint.Z off) ls.unpersisted ls.stored) (Hpend : PendLogOk σ ls) (Hfl : FlOk σ ls)
    (Hlnt : ls.lent = false) : uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ
    σ.pend).length

theorem ownUnstable_return [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : ⊢
    (∀ uv, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l) uv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ typedPointsto
    l { storage' := lv.storage', unstable' := uv, committed' := lv.committed', applying' :=
    lv.applying', applied' := lv.applied', logger' := lv.logger', maxApplyingEntsSize' :=
    lv.maxApplyingEntsSize', applyingEntsSize' := lv.applyingEntsSize', applyingEntsPaused' :=
    lv.applyingEntsPaused' } (DFrac.own 1)) -∗ ownUnstable (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l)
    (unstableOf lv ls) -∗ ∃ uv, typedPointsto l { storage' := lv.storage', unstable' := uv,
    committed' := lv.committed', applying' := lv.applying', applied' := lv.applied', logger' :=
    lv.logger', maxApplyingEntsSize' := lv.maxApplyingEntsSize', applyingEntsSize' :=
    lv.applyingEntsSize', applyingEntsPaused' := lv.applyingEntsPaused' } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSliceCap Loc uv.entries' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ entsRO uv.entries' ls.uents ∗ ownSnap uv.snapshot'
    ls.snap ∗ pendKsn uv.snapshot' ls.snap ls.ksn ∗ isLoggerVal uv.logger' ∗ ⌜uv.offset' =
    lv.unstable'.offset'⌝ ∗ ⌜uv.offsetInProgress' = ls.inprogress⌝ ∗ ⌜uv.snapshotInProgress' =
    ls.sip⌝

def LogStoreOk (snap : Option entryID) (σ : StorState) (prev : entryID) (sents uents : List EntryM)
    : Prop :=
  match snap with
  | none => σ.prev = prev ∧ sents <+: σ.ents ∧ (uents = [] → sents = σ.ents)
  | some sid => prev = sid ∧ sents = [] ∧ 0 < uint.Z sid.index' ∧ uint.Z sid.index' < 2 ^ 61

def unstableOf (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : UnstableSt :=
  { ents := ls.uents, offset := lv.unstable'.offset', inprogress := ls.inprogress, snap := ls.snap, ksn := ls.ksn,
    sip := ls.sip }

theorem logTruncInprogress_lt {ls : LogState} {f : w64} (h : uint.Z (logTruncInprogress ls f) <
    uint.Z ls.inprogress) : logTruncInprogress ls f = f

theorem ownRaftLogW_snap_prev [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLogW
    l ls -∗ ⌜∀ (sid : entryID), ls.snap = some sid → sid = ls.prev⌝ ∗ ownRaftLogW l ls

theorem ownSnap_None [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) : ownSnap p none ⊣⊢ ⌜p = null⌝

theorem isLoggerVal_open [package_sem : Assumptions] (x : GoInterface) : isLoggerVal x ⊢ ∃ lg, ⌜x =
    GoInterface.ok lg⌝ ∗ isLogger lg

theorem ownUnstable_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (u : Loc) (uv : unstable) (ents : List EntryM)
    (off ip : w64) (snap : Option entryID) (K : List SnapTrip) (sip : Bool) : ⊢ typedPointsto u uv
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSliceCap Loc uv.entries' (DFrac.own 1) -∗ entsRO uv.entries' ents -∗ ownSnap
    uv.snapshot' snap -∗ pendKsn uv.snapshot' snap K -∗ isLoggerVal uv.logger' -∗ ⌜uv.offset' = off
    ∧ uv.offsetInProgress' = ip ∧ uv.snapshotInProgress' = sip⌝ -∗ ownUnstable u { ents := ents,
    offset := off, inprogress := ip, snap := snap, ksn := K, sip := sip }

def logTruncateAppend (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) : LogState :=
  match ents with
  | [] => ls
  | e0 :: tail =>
    { prev := ls.prev, sents := List.take (uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z ls.prev.index' - 1).toNat ls.sents,
      uents := List.take (uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z ls.prev.index' - 1 - ↑ls.sents.length).toNat ls.uents ++ ents,
      committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress := logTruncInprogress ls e0.Index',
      applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax,
      storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps,
      sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt }

theorem ownRaftLogW_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLogW l
    ls -∗ ∃ lv, typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ⌜lv.applied' = ls.applied ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤
    uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z
    ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.prev.index' < uint.Z ls.inprogress⌝ ∗ (typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1)
    -∗ ownRaftLogW l ls)

theorem ownRaftLog_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) (st : Storage) (σ :
    StorState) (snap : Option entryID) (uents : List EntryM) (ls : LogState) {K : List SnapTrip} {lt
    : Bool} : lv.storage' = st → lv.committed' = ls.committed → lv.applied' = ls.applied →
    LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) → uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length +
    ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → LogStoreOk ls.snap σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents → uint.Z
    lv.unstable'.offset' = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤
    uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed → (ls.snap = none → uint.Z
    ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied) → uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' +
    ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length → (ls.snap = none → StoredSnapOk σ ls.committed ls.prev
    (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)) → lv.applying' = ls.applying → lv.unstable'.offsetInProgress' =
    ls.inprogress → uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧ uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤
    uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' + ↑ls.uents.length → (ls.snap = none → LogPersistOk σ ls.sents
    ls.uents (uint.Z ls.inprogress - uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset') ls.unpersisted ls.stored) → uint.Z
    ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed →
    (lv.applyingEntsPaused' = false → uint.Z ls.apsize < uint.Z ls.apmax) → lv.applyingEntsSize' =
    ls.apsize → lv.maxApplyingEntsSize' = ls.apmax → lv.storage' = ls.storage → PendLogOk σ ls →
    FlOk σ ls → (σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 → { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈
    ls.ksn) → lv.unstable'.snapshotInProgress' = ls.sip → (ls.snap = none → ls.sip = false) →
    (ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none) → ls.sapp = false ∧ ls.aps = false → SipOk ls
    lv.unstable'.offset' → (ls.sat = true → SatOk σ ls) → ls.snap = snap → ls.uents = uents → ls.ksn
    = K → ls.lent = lt → ⊢ typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ isStorage st -∗ lentStor lt st σ -∗
    ownSnap lv.unstable'.snapshot' snap -∗ pendKsn lv.unstable'.snapshot' snap K -∗ ([∗list] k ∈ K,
    storCert st k) -∗ entsRO lv.unstable'.entries' uents -∗ ownSliceCap Loc lv.unstable'.entries'
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ isLoggerVal lv.logger' -∗ isLoggerVal lv.unstable'.logger' -∗ ownRaftLog l ls

def scanClosure (f : GoFunc) (L : List EntryM) (I : List EntryM → IProp GF) (B : GoInterface → IProp
    GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ s acc es dq,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          entsPts s dq es ∗ ⌜es ≠ [] ∧ acc ++ es <+: L⌝ ∗ I acc -∗
            (▷
                ∀ err,
                  entsPts s dq es ∗ (⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ I (acc ++ es) ∨ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ B err) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal f) (intoVal s)) {{ Φ }})

theorem ownSnap_unseal [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) : ownSnap p
    snap = ownSnapDef p snap

theorem SipOk.applying_ltW {ls : LogState} {σ : StorState} {off a : w64} (H : SipOk ls off) (Hst :
    LogStoreOk (snapV ls) σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents) (Hsapp : ls.sapp = true → SappOk σ ls) (Hoff
    : uint.Z off = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1) (Ha : ls.snap ≠ none → ls.sip =
    false → uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∨ uint.Z a < uint.Z ls.prev.index') : ls.snap ≠ none →
    ls.sip = false → ls.inprogress = off ∧ uint.Z a < uint.Z ls.prev.index'

theorem ownRaftLog_wf [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗
    ⌜LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

def logTruncInprogress (ls : LogState) (f : w64) : w64 :=
  if uint.Z f < uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 then
    if uint.Z f < uint.Z ls.inprogress then f else ls.inprogress
  else ls.inprogress

theorem stored_take_visible (prev : entryID) (sents stored : List EntryM) (hi : w64) (e : EntryM)
    (Hpre : sents <+: stored) (Hhi : uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z prev.index' + ↑sents.length + 1) (He : e ∈
    List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z prev.index' - 1).toNat stored) : e ∈ sents

def EntryNormal : w32 :=
  W32 0

theorem ownRaftLog_committed [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l
    ls -∗ ⌜(uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧
    uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length) ∧ (ls.snap =
    none → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied)⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

theorem unstableOf.proj_sip (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).sip = ls.sip

def SnpKeep (ls ls' : LogState) : Prop :=
  ls'.lent = ls.lent ∧
    ls'.sip = ls.sip ∧
      ls'.sat = ls.sat ∧ ls'.ksn = ls.ksn ∧ ls'.sxt = ls.sxt ∧ ls'.aps = ls.aps ∧ ls'.applying = ls.applying

theorem ownRaftLogW_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) (st : Storage) (σ :
    StorState) (snap : Option entryID) (uents : List EntryM) (ls : LogState) {K : List SnapTrip} {lt
    : Bool} : lv.storage' = st → lv.committed' = ls.committed → lv.applied' = ls.applied →
    LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) → uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length +
    ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → LogStoreOk (snapV ls) σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents → uint.Z
    lv.unstable'.offset' = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤
    uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed → (ls.snap = none → ls.aps = false
    → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied) → uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' +
    ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length → (snapV ls = none → StoredSnapOk σ ls.committed ls.prev
    (ls.sents ++ ls.uents)) → lv.applying' = ls.applying → lv.unstable'.offsetInProgress' =
    ls.inprogress → uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧ uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤
    uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' + ↑ls.uents.length → (snapV ls = none → LogPersistOk σ ls.sents
    ls.uents (uint.Z ls.inprogress - uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset') ls.unpersisted ls.stored) → uint.Z
    ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed →
    (lv.applyingEntsPaused' = false → uint.Z ls.apsize < uint.Z ls.apmax) → lv.applyingEntsSize' =
    ls.apsize → lv.maxApplyingEntsSize' = ls.apmax → lv.storage' = ls.storage → PendLogOk σ ls →
    FlOk σ ls → (σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 → { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈
    ls.ksn) → lv.unstable'.snapshotInProgress' = ls.sip → (ls.snap = none → ls.sip = false) →
    (ls.lent = true → ls.snap ≠ none) → (ls.sapp = true → SappOk σ ls) → SipOk ls
    lv.unstable'.offset' → (ls.sat = true → SatOk σ ls) → ls.snap = snap → ls.uents = uents → ls.ksn
    = K → ls.lent = lt → ⊢ typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ isStorage st -∗ lentStor lt st σ -∗
    ownSnap lv.unstable'.snapshot' snap -∗ pendKsn lv.unstable'.snapshot' snap K -∗ ([∗list] k ∈ K,
    storCert st k) -∗ entsRO lv.unstable'.entries' uents -∗ ownSliceCap Loc lv.unstable'.entries'
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ isLoggerVal lv.logger' -∗ isLoggerVal lv.unstable'.logger' -∗ ownRaftLogW l ls

theorem ownRaftLog_raise_floor [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (x : w64) (Hx :
    uint.Z ls.fl ≤ uint.Z x ∧ uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z ls.applying) (Hunp : ls.unpersisted = []) (Hlnt :
    ls.lent = false) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls ==∗ ownRaftLog l { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents,
    uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress
    := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored,
    apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := x, sip :=
    ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt } ∗
    storFloor ls.storage x

def FlOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  σ.fl = ls.fl ∧
    uint.Z ls.fl ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying < uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧ PendAbove σ σ.pend ∧ StorExtOk σ ls

def SnpOk (g : NGhost) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  ls.lent = g.slent ∧
    (∀ (k : SnapTrip),
        g.snp = some k →
          (ls.snap = some k.sid → ls.sip = true ∧ (ls.lent = true ∨ ls.sat = true)) ∧
            k ∈ ls.ksn ∧ uint.Z k.sid.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed) ∧
      (ls.sip = true ∨ ls.sat = true → g.snp ≠ none) ∧
        (ls.sip = true ∨ ls.sat = true → ∃ k, g.snp = some k ∧ ls.snap = some k.sid) ∧ SnpExt g ls

def lentStor (b : Bool) (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  if b = true then iprop(True) else ownStorage st σ

def LogIndicesOk (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z prev.index' + ↑(k + 1)

theorem unstableOf.proj_offset (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) : (unstableOf lv ls).offset =
    lv.unstable'.offset'

theorem SnpOk.restore {g : NGhost} {ls : LogState} (k : SnapTrip) (H : SnpOk g ls) (Hgt : uint.Z
    ls.committed < uint.Z k.sid.index') (Haps : ls.aps = false) : SnpOk g (logRestore ls k)

theorem StoredSnapOk_commit (σ : StorState) (cm cm' : w64) (prev : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (Hle
    : uint.Z cm ≤ uint.Z cm') (H : StoredSnapOk σ cm prev es) : StoredSnapOk σ cm' prev es

def ownSnapDef (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) : IProp GF :=
  match snap with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some sid =>
    iprop(∃ sv, ownSnapM p DFrac.discard sv ∗ ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = sid.index' ∧ sv.Metadata'.Term' = sid.term'⌝)

def TruncAt (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) (i : w64) : Prop :=
  uint.Z ls.committed < uint.Z i ∧ ∃ e, e ∈ ents ∧ e.Index' = i ∧ ¬PlogMatches ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) (entId e)

def unstableSnapTo (us : UnstableSt) (i : w64) : UnstableSt :=
  if snapHit us.snap i = true then
    { ents := us.ents, offset := us.offset, inprogress := us.inprogress, snap := none, ksn := us.ksn }
  else us

theorem termAt_log_below (σ : StorState) (sents uents : List EntryM) (ipo : Int) (pend stored : List
    EntryM) (idx t : w64) (Hp : LogPersistOk σ sents uents ipo pend stored) (Hipo : 0 ≤ ipo ∧ ipo ≤
    ↑uents.length) (Hge : uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z idx) (Hlt : uint.Z idx < uint.Z
    σ.prev.index' + ↑sents.length + ipo + 1) (Hab : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), pend.head? = some e0 → uint.Z
    idx < uint.Z e0.Index') (Ht : termAt σ.prev σ.ents idx = some t) : plogTermAt σ.prev (sents ++
    uents) idx = some t

def logAdopts (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) : Bool :=
  match ents with
  | [] => false
  | e0 :: tail =>
    decide
      (uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 ∧
        uint.Z e0.Index' ≠ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1)

theorem lentStor_lent {b : Bool} (h : b = true) (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : ⊢ lentStor b st σ

theorem SipOk.applying_lt {ls : LogState} {σ : StorState} {off a : w64} (H : SipOk ls off) (_Hst :
    LogStoreOk ls.snap σ ls.prev ls.sents ls.uents) (_Hoff : uint.Z off = uint.Z ls.prev.index' +
    ↑ls.sents.length + 1) (Ha : ls.snap ≠ none → ls.sip = false → uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∨
    uint.Z a < uint.Z ls.prev.index') : ls.snap ≠ none → ls.sip = false → ls.inprogress = off ∧
    uint.Z a < uint.Z ls.prev.index'

theorem snapV_of {ls : LogState} (h : ls.sapp = false) : snapV ls = ls.snap

theorem initKsn_mem (σ : StorState) (h : σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0) : { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al :=
    σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat } ∈ initKsn σ

theorem pendFrom_of_logOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) (Hp : PendLogOk σ ls) (Hs : ls.snap =
    none) (n : Int) (Hn : n ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1) : PendFrom σ n

syntax tacticReopen_unstable

theorem ownRaftLog_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls
    -∗ ∃ lv, typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ⌜lv.committed' = ls.committed ∧ lv.applied' =
    ls.applied⌝ ∗ (typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownRaftLog l ls)

syntax tacticLend_unstable

theorem ownSlice_same_ptr_len [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V]
    (s1 s2 : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (vs : List V) : vs ≠ [] → s1.ptr = s2.ptr → s1.len = s2.len →
    sint.Z s2.len ≤ sint.Z s2.cap → ⊢ ownSlice s1 vs dq -∗ ownSlice s2 vs dq

theorem ownUnstable_open [package_sem : Assumptions] (u : Loc) (us : UnstableSt) : ⊢ ownUnstable u
    us -∗ ∃ uv, typedPointsto u { snapshot' := uv.snapshot', entries' := uv.entries', offset' :=
    us.offset, snapshotInProgress' := us.sip, offsetInProgress' := us.inprogress, logger' :=
    uv.logger' } (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSliceCap Loc uv.entries' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ entsRO uv.entries'
    us.ents ∗ ownSnap uv.snapshot' us.snap ∗ pendKsn uv.snapshot' us.snap us.ksn ∗ isLoggerVal
    uv.logger'

theorem ownSnap_pers [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (snap : Option entryID) : Persistent
    (ownSnap p snap)

theorem logTruncateAppend_cont (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) (H : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), ents[0]? =
    some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1) :
    logTruncateAppend ls ents = logAppend ls ents ∧ logAdopts ls ents = false

def PendLogOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  σ.pend = ls.unpersisted ∧
    (ls.snap = none →
      ∀ (e0 : EntryM), ls.unpersisted.head? = some e0 → uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 ≤ uint.Z e0.Index')

theorem SnpOk.of_fields {g : NGhost} {ls ls' : LogState} (H : SnpOk g ls) (hlt : ls'.lent = ls.lent)
    (hsn : ls'.snap = ls.snap) (hsip : ls'.sip = ls.sip) (hsat : ls'.sat = ls.sat) (hk : ls'.ksn =
    ls.ksn) (hcm : uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls'.committed) (hx : SnpExt g ls → SnpExt g ls' :=
    by exact fun h => h) : SnpOk g ls'

theorem ownRaftLog_toW [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ownRaftLog l ls ⊢
    ownRaftLogW l ls

theorem ownRaftLog_pure [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (φ : Prop) (H : ∀ (lv
    : raftLog) (σ : StorState), LogIndicesOk ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) → uint.Z ls.prev.index'
    + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → LogStoreOk ls.snap σ ls.prev ls.sents
    ls.uents → uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' = uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 → uint.Z
    ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∧ uint.Z ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.committed → (ls.snap = none
    → uint.Z ls.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.applied) → uint.Z ls.committed ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' +
    ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length → uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧
    uint.Z ls.inprogress ≤ uint.Z lv.unstable'.offset' + ↑ls.uents.length → uint.Z ls.applied ≤
    uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed → φ) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l ls -∗ ⌜φ⌝ ∗
    ownRaftLog l ls

theorem ownRaftLog_stable_bound [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog
    l ls -∗ ⌜uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

def StorExtOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  ls.snap ≠ none →
    ls.lent = false →
      uint.Z ls.sxt ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ σ.pend).length ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.sxt

theorem ownUnstable_reopen [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) (us : UnstableSt) :
    ⊢ (∀ uv, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l) uv (DFrac.own 1) -∗
    typedPointsto l { storage' := lv.storage', unstable' := uv, committed' := lv.committed',
    applying' := lv.applying', applied' := lv.applied', logger' := lv.logger', maxApplyingEntsSize'
    := lv.maxApplyingEntsSize', applyingEntsSize' := lv.applyingEntsSize', applyingEntsPaused' :=
    lv.applyingEntsPaused' } (DFrac.own 1)) -∗ ownUnstable (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l)
    us -∗ ∃ uv, typedPointsto l { storage' := lv.storage', unstable' := uv, committed' :=
    lv.committed', applying' := lv.applying', applied' := lv.applied', logger' := lv.logger',
    maxApplyingEntsSize' := lv.maxApplyingEntsSize', applyingEntsSize' := lv.applyingEntsSize',
    applyingEntsPaused' := lv.applyingEntsPaused' } (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSliceCap Loc uv.entries'
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ entsRO uv.entries' us.ents ∗ ownSnap uv.snapshot' us.snap ∗ pendKsn uv.snapshot'
    us.snap us.ksn ∗ isLoggerVal uv.logger' ∗ ⌜uv.offset' = us.offset⌝ ∗ ⌜uv.offsetInProgress' =
    us.inprogress⌝ ∗ ⌜uv.snapshotInProgress' = us.sip⌝

theorem lentStor_open {b : Bool} (h : b = false) (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : lentStor b st σ ⊢
    ownStorage st σ

theorem ownRaftLog_sapp [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) (Hs : ls.sat = true) :
    ownRaftLog l ls ⊢ ownRaftLogW l { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents,
    committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress,
    applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored, apsize :=
    ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip,
    lent := ls.lent, sapp := true, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt }

theorem ownRaftLog_ready_wf [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ls : LogState) : ⊢ ownRaftLog l
    ls -∗ ⌜(uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + 1 ≤ uint.Z ls.inprogress ∧ uint.Z
    ls.inprogress ≤ uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1) ∧ uint.Z
    ls.applied ≤ uint.Z ls.applying ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.committed⌝ ∗ ownRaftLog l ls

def SappOk (σ : StorState) (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  ls.snap = some ls.prev ∧ ls.sip = true ∧ ls.lent = false ∧ ls.unpersisted = [] ∧ σ.ss = ls.prev

syntax tacticReseal_raftLogW

theorem raftLog_lend_unstable [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (lv : raftLog) (ls : LogState) :
    lv.unstable'.offsetInProgress' = ls.inprogress → lv.unstable'.snapshotInProgress' = ls.sip → ⊢
    typedPointsto l lv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSliceCap Loc lv.unstable'.entries' (DFrac.own 1) -∗
    entsRO lv.unstable'.entries' ls.uents -∗ ownSnap lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap -∗ pendKsn
    lv.unstable'.snapshot' ls.snap ls.ksn -∗ isLoggerVal lv.unstable'.logger' -∗ ownUnstable
    (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l) (unstableOf lv ls) ∗ ∀ uv, typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef raftLog go!"unstable" l) uv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ typedPointsto l { storage' :=
    lv.storage', unstable' := uv, committed' := lv.committed', applying' := lv.applying', applied'
    := lv.applied', logger' := lv.logger', maxApplyingEntsSize' := lv.maxApplyingEntsSize',
    applyingEntsSize' := lv.applyingEntsSize', applyingEntsPaused' := lv.applyingEntsPaused' }
    (DFrac.own 1)

theorem plogTermAt_truncateAppend_below (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) (e0 : EntryM) (i t :
    w64) (H0 : ents[0]? = some e0) (Hlt : uint.Z i < uint.Z e0.Index') (Ht : plogTermAt b es i =
    some t) : plogTermAt b (plogTruncateAppend b es ents) i = some t
